values.note: 2026 rates for 2 adults and children under 16 per camping unit: 20/30-amp $35, 50-amp $40; rustic sites (no hookups) $30; $5 per extra adult. Seasonal $2,100 a year plus utilities. Deposit $20 per day of the stay; 7-day cancellation notice.

fees.source: https://www.maplerivercampground.com/Rates.html ('2026 Rates ... 50 amp service $40.00 a night 30/20 amp service $35.00 a night Rustic sites- no hook ups $30.00 a night Guest fee $5.00 per adult extra'; 'Seasonal $2,100.00 a year plus utilities') + https://www.maplerivercampground.com/Reservations.html ('Deposit of $ 20.00 per day for your stay', '7 day cancellation notice'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.maplerivercampground.com/Rates.html ('We are open from May 1st to November 1st'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.maplerivercampground.com/ ('20/30/ 50 Amp Service'; lists a honeywagon and dumping station but no water hookups) + Rates.html (rates by amp service only), read 2026-10-22. The stored water: true was derived from note prose the operator's pages do not support, so it is cleared.

values.note: The operator's site map numbers about 65 sites: about 26 transient sites (green) mostly along the river and about 39 seasonal sites (red, numbers 12-50 away from the river).

sites.source: https://www.maplerivercampground.com/Sitemap.html (site map image: 'Campsites in GREEN, Seasonal sites in RED'), read 2026-10-22. The stored count of 63 came from note prose and no operator page states a count, so it is cleared.

values.note: Wi-Fi through a pay portal. Handicapped-accessible shower house; honeywagon; LP fill; firewood and ice; live bait. Dump fee $5 ($10 for off-site rigs).

facilities.source: https://www.maplerivercampground.com/ ('WI-FI available thru pay portal', 'Shower House (Handicapped accessible)', 'Honeywagon', 'Dumping Station', 'LP Fill Station') + Reservations.html ('$5.00 dumping fee $10.00 dumping fee (off road)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve with the office (summer phone hours 10am-5pm); sites are not guaranteed and may be reassigned. Check-in 2pm, check-out noon; Friday check-in until 8pm.

booking.source: https://www.maplerivercampground.com/Reservations.html ('3 day minimum for Holiday Weekends', 'Office Hours Summer-10am to 5pm for phone service', 'Check in 2pm check out noon', 'Friday open until 8pm for check ins') + home page ('we can not guarantee assigned sites and may have to re-assign sites'), read 2026-10-22

note: Private campground on the banks of the Maple River opposite public state land; large riverfront transient sites plus rustic and primitive sites, a boat launch and live bait for fishing. Most numbered sites away from the river are seasonal (operator's site map). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's own site: 2026 $35 (20/30-amp) to $40 (50-amp), rustic $30, open May 1 - Nov 1, 50-amp, showers/dump, reserve with the office, phone 989-981-6792. Added wifi (pay portal), 3-night holiday minimum, booking platform phone, fee notes (deposit is $20/day, not the note's $10). Cleared derived water hookups and the 63-site count (operator states neither). Note trimmed. Not stated: max rig length, pull-throughs, discounts.
flags: Mostly seasonal: the operator's site map marks about 39 of about 65 numbered sites as seasonal (red, numbers 12-50) and about 26 as transient (green, mostly riverfront), so roughly 60% seasonal. It still sells nights at posted 2026 rates ($35-40) with reservations, so long-stay tests 2 and 4 pass (about 40% sold nightly). Price under US$50 (no gateway within 40 km; nearest Grand Rapids 69 km).
